_README: Permission rules for cowock. To ACTIVATE: rename this file to 'settings.json' (in the .claude/ folder), then start a NEW Claude Code session on this branch. Permission rules load at session start, so a fresh session is required. Renaming is done by you (the human) on purpose — an agent is not allowed to grant itself these permissions. The Buffer rules let the agent publish; the cowock-social rules let it drive the social app's own MCP server.
